skins.style_brief: Eurylochus, Odysseus's blunt second-in-command (Odyssey Book 9). A weathered, sun-cured ship's officer: full grey-streaked dark beard, a rust-red exomis tunic cinched by a worn leather belt, bare tanned arms and legs, plain deck sandals. Reads as older, authoritative, out of patience.

Perimedes, the quiet strong hand of Odysseus's crew (Odyssey Book 9). A younger deckhand with a short near-black beard and hollow, sleepless eyes; a sea-teal exomis over sea-paled skin, a dark rope-and-leather belt, worn sandals. Reads as steady but haunted.
